sn35.88:1.1: This sutta recurs at [mn145](), with slight differences in the opening and closing. In addition to two discourse parallels in Chinese, the popularity of this narrative is attested by its appearance in later texts such as the Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya and the Divyāvadāna, as well as in artworks (see Anālayo, *Comparative Study*, vol. ii, p. 828).
sn35.88:8.2: BB’s “give me a blow with a clod” sounds odd, and is overly literal. “Stoning” with leddu is commonly mentioned in both Pali and Sanskrit.
